tagline: 122 × 89cm, with a bolster on three sides for a big dog who likes to lean.
lead: A big dog gets all of themselves on the bed, back legs included, with a bolster to press against.
value: At 122 × 89cm it has around 70% more floor area than a typical 90 × 70cm large bed, with memory foam underneath.
intro: Hawthorn is an XL orthopaedic bolster dog bed, 122 × 89cm and 18cm deep, with memory foam and an egg-crate layer, a U-shaped bolster on three sides, a textured plush surface and a waterproof inner layer.
points: The U-shaped surround gives a chin, a back or a hip something to lean into.
No wall to step over, and the shape never feels boxed in.
Paired with an egg-crate profiled layer, under a textured plush sleeping surface.
Easy to get off, so it actually gets washed.
best_for: Big dogs who lean against a surround, and owners who are tired of fighting a cover back on.
fit_note: These are outside measurements and the bolster takes up some of that. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15–20cm. Not sure? Ask us with their breed and weight.
care: Open the cover, remove it and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.
seo_title: Extra Large Memory Foam Bolster Dog Bed, 122cm | Snoozly
seo_description: An extra large memory foam bolster dog bed, 122 × 89cm, so big dogs fit on it rather than around it. U-shaped bolster, open front, waterproof inner layer.
alt: Hawthorn XL orthopaedic bolster dog bed
